nodes.label: Refresh token (14d) single-use rotation
nodes.author: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash
nodes.rationale: Each refresh returns a rotated pair and invalidates the presented token so a stolen refresh token cannot be replayed

nodes.label: Refresh token family revocation on replay
nodes.author: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash
nodes.norm_label: refresh token family revocation on replay
nodes.rationale: Since ADR-22 replaying a rotated token is treated as suspected theft and the whole family is revoked, including the freshly rotated token

nodes.label: Two-layer login lockout
nodes.author: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash
nodes.rationale: 5 failures per email+IP lock that pair for 15 min; 20 failures per email across IPs lock the email, so hammering a victim address no longer locks the victim out from their own network
